title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Membership and Marlowe Rewards Points Reversal
content:
A Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan sets a membership share. The membership share weights the Marlowe Rewards points taken back when a return is refunded. The reversed spend enters the points reversed multiplied by this share, and the share is not rounded on its own.

## The membership share

| Unlimited plan held by the member | Plan status | Membership share |
|---|---|---|
| An annual plan: Unlimited Student Annual, Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Annual or Unlimited Next-Day Annual | active or cancellation pending | 90 percent |
| A monthly plan: Unlimited Standard Monthly or Unlimited Express Monthly | active or cancellation pending | 95 percent |
| Any other position: no plan, or a plan in trial, past due or expired | any | 100 percent |

## Points of judgement

- A plan whose cancellation is pending is still in status cancellation pending, so it keeps its 90 or 95 percent share.
- A plan in trial does not give a reduced share.

## Illustration (hypothetical reversed spend of 80.00 USD)

| Member's plan | Reversed spend as weighted |
|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Annual, active | 72.00 |
| Unlimited Express Monthly, cancellation pending | 76.00 |
| Unlimited Standard Monthly, expired | 80.00 |
